summary: Baozun Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to report the submission of a monthly return to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited for August 2026, detailing movements in authorized share capital and issued shares. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure required of a dual-listed foreign private issuer. It contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or management change. The monthly return confirms no changes to authorized share capital during the period. The filing is procedural in nature and does not constitute a special situation.
